cases.evidence: The generic collision-checked runner created the preregistered build_output directory before the unchanged frozen bootstrap. The bootstrap crossed its prior pre-install mv failure, installed successfully, and passed its isolated metadata-derived import probe after network disconnection.

After user confirmation of a WiFi change, the unchanged frozen bootstrap completed in one allowed attempt. Both metadata-derived probes passed after every Docker network was disconnected. This is consistent with, but does not by itself prove, the Round 10 timeout classification.

causal_checks.round10_pass_non_regression: Gpkit, Reticulum, and pytest-xdist retained V3 Pass under identical revised verifier policies.
causal_checks.inflect_fixture: Observed the preregistered transition from a pre-install missing-directory failure to bootstrap and V3 Pass without repository-name branching or source changes.
causal_checks.poetry_network: Observed recovery after the preregistered user-confirmed network transition; no verifier or bootstrap policy changed.
causal_checks.fail_closed_collection: All five cases completed collection with zero errors; no partial-collection aggregation path was needed.
causal_checks.network_isolation: All 24 probes executed only after Docker reported an empty connected-network set and the in-container default-route check was false.

conclusions: The revised benchmark-independent V3 contract has clean Dev-5 evidence across both legacy editable and PEP 610 project provenance.
Round 11 closes the revised V3 replay requirement but does not establish V1, V4, V6, Official Pass, held-out generalization, or leaderboard improvement.
The build_output value is an external experiment-fixture declaration; the runner mechanism is generic, collision checked, temporary, and contains no case-name dispatch.
